title: VASP density of states
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-dos workflow: it computes the electronic density of states and band gaps of a structure with VASP, a self-consistent run (or a given charge density) followed by a non-self-consistent run on a dense uniform k-point mesh.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure whose density of states is computed.
Output role total_energy is a records entry containing the total energy of the self-consistent run when this job ran it, output role electronic_density_of_states is a records entry containing the total electronic density of states of the non-self-consistent run, output role fermi_energy is a records entry containing the Fermi energy of the non-self-consistent run, output role band_gap is a records entry containing the band gap on the uniform mesh (0 for a metal), output role direct_band_gap is a records entry containing the smallest spin-conserving direct band gap on the uniform mesh (0 for a metal), output role dos is a files entry containing the DOSCAR of the non-self-consistent run, output role eigenvalues is a files entry containing the EIGENVAL of the non-self-consistent run on the uniform mesh, and output role band_edges is a files entry containing band_edges.json: the band edges, gaps and Fermi energy (per spin channel when spin-polarized).

inputs.name: initial_structure
inputs.description: The structure whose density of states is computed.

outputs.name: total_energy
outputs.description: The total energy of the self-consistent run when this job ran it.

outputs.name: electronic_density_of_states
outputs.description: The total electronic density of states of the non-self-consistent run.

outputs.name: fermi_energy
outputs.description: The Fermi energy of the non-self-consistent run.

outputs.name: band_gap
outputs.description: The band gap on the uniform mesh (0 for a metal).

outputs.name: direct_band_gap
outputs.description: The smallest spin-conserving direct band gap on the uniform mesh (0 for a metal).

outputs.name: eigenvalues
outputs.description: EIGENVAL of the non-self-consistent run on the uniform mesh.

outputs.name: band_edges
outputs.description: band_edges.json: the band edges, gaps and Fermi energy (per spin channel when spin-polarized).
